effects.target: A rope-like object of up to 50 feet plus 5 feet per caster level shrinks into an arrow, bolt or similar ammunition you can shoot at any Medium or larger object. effects.target: Using a Harrow deck, you tell a fortune for yourself or a creature you stay adjacent to for the whole 10-minute casting. The harrowing must name one set of events or course of action the subject intends to undertake during the duration. Draw nine cards — or simulate each with a d6 and a d10 — and record the ability score and alignment of each.

Each card modifies a specific kind of d20 check, by how well its alignment matches the subject's. Identical alignment: a +2 luck bonus on that suit's check. Opposed alignment: a -1 penalty. Any other alignment: a +1 luck bonus.
Suit to check: Hammer (Str) attack rolls, melee and ranged; Key (Dex) Reflex saves; Shield (Con) Fortitude saves; Book (Int) skill checks; Star (Wis) Will saves; Crown (Cha) any d20 roll.

Opposition alignments: LG opposes CE, NG opposes NE, CG opposes LE, LN opposes CN, CN opposes LN, LE opposes CG, NE opposes NG, CE opposes LG. For N, pick one of LG, LE, CG or CE when the spell is cast.

Penalties apply to every associated check for as long as the harrowing lasts. Bonuses are one-use: the subject spends each one to modify that card's check, and may do so after rolling the die but not after learning the result. All the bonuses are luck bonuses and do not stack with each other; the penalties do stack. When every bonus is spent, or the duration ends, the spell ends and the penalties lift. A creature can be under only one harrowing at a time — a second one cast on it automatically fails.

harrowing.notes: The bonuses and penalties are determined per card by a draw made at casting, against the subject's alignment, so no fixed modifier spec could be emitted — the same casting produces different numbers for different subjects. Duration is 'days/level or until discharged'.

Books: as a standard action grant yourself a +4 enhancement bonus to Intelligence for 1 minute, during which you gain a +3 enhancement bonus on checks with every skill you have no ranks in, and may use those skills even when they normally cannot be used untrained.

Stars: as a standard action grant yourself a +4 enhancement bonus to Wisdom for 1 minute, during which you are immune to one of charm and compulsion effects, curse effects, or fear effects — your choice.

Crowns: as a standard action grant yourself a +4 enhancement bonus to Charisma for 1 minute, during which any Diplomacy or Intimidate check that successfully improves a nonhostile creature's attitude makes that creature helpful for the rest of the bonus's duration, however many steps that would normally be; it reverts when the duration ends.
A creature can be under only one harrowing or greater harrowing at a time; a second automatically fails for that subject.
